_publications._publicationTitle: Traditional and systems biology based drug discovery for the rare tumor syndrome neurofibromatosis type 2
_publications._context: Merlin-null (Nf2ex2-/-) mouse Schwann cell line, derived the same way as MS03 (dorsal root ganglia of PostnCre;Nf2flox/flox mice via Cre-lox recombination), as part of the CTF Synodos for NF2 drug discovery program.

basicInfo.description: Merlin-null (Nf2ex2-/-) mouse Schwann cell line from the Synodos NF2 consortium panel, derived from dorsal root ganglia of PostnCre;Nf2flox/flox mice via Cre-lox recombination (same derivation as MS03).
